g.metadata: CodeInternX official Internship Completion Certificate master. Company: CodeInternX. Phone: 9508574636. Email: internxcode@gmail.com. Website: codeinternx.com. Signatory: Shani Bharadwaj, Co-Founder. Dynamic fields: recipientName, domain, startDate, endDate, issueDate, certificateId, verificationQr. Verification URL: https://codeinternx.com/verify/certificate/{certificateId} The certificate ID is visibly printed on the certificate and is the unique key used for verification. The verification QR is candidate-specific and must be regenerated before issuance.
